Objective: Premium currency tied to worker satisfaction
What_to_learn: If premium currency touches happiness/efficiency, provide transparent free-earn paths and avoid emotionally punitive pressure.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not make cute-character distress the primary pressure for premium spend.

What_to_learn: Define exactly what ad-free removes and preserve that contract across later monetization changes.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not reintroduce ad surfaces that violate reasonable permanent-purchase expectations.

What_to_learn: Separate client preload from activation and reserve immediate stabilization capacity.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not infer event activation from version date or assume preload is quality-complete.
